Sam (CEO): Quick weekly — high-level notes and 3 asks for the org.
Sam (CEO): Wins: Dedicated GA met internal SLA 99.95% last week; hosted API p50 latency 48ms (down ~10%). Closed 3 Dedicated contracts this quarter (~$1.2M ARR annualized).
Sam (CEO): Focus this week: 1) roll out private deployment security checklist, 2) cost-reduction sprint (target -15% unit cost by end of Q2), 3) APAC region ramp and partner onboarding.
Sam (CEO): Snapshot metrics: MRR +14% MoM, API QPS +34% YoY, mean token cost down 6%. Full dashboard: https://console.redwood.ai/ops/dashboards/exec
Jordan (VP Eng): Big congrats to infra and runtime teams. Note: we still see tail spikes on long-context in a small subset of requests; KV cache tuning is scheduled for deploy today.
Priya (VP Product): Product update: streaming function-calls beta to 50 partners next Tue. Need docs + migration guide (priority).
Lina (CFO): Finance update: runway healthy. FY27 planning doc drops next Thurs. Heads-up: submit headcount and contractor requests by EOD Friday for this budgeting cycle.
Sam (CEO): Asks: A) Eng — prioritize tail-latency fix and canary it this week. B) Product — publish migration guide & sample app. C) CS/Sales — confirm renewals for 3 upsell opportunities in Dedicated.
Jordan (VP Eng): On A — we've got a repro, PR#452 in review with benchmark results. Canary rollout tonight; will monitor p99 and error rates. /cc @Priya for validation.
Priya (VP Product): On B — docs + samples pairing with eng; draft goes to product/docs this afternoon.
Lina (CFO): On C — RevOps will send a renewal list to sales@ and loop CS for outreach.
Sam (CEO): Risk note: EMEA compliance audit scheduled for May 6. Private deployment customers may need extra attestation; Security team owns prep.
SecurityBot: New task created: GDPR_audit_prep-382 assigned to @security_lead. Link: https://tasks.redwood.ai/382
Jordan (VP Eng): Ops note: pausing non-critical infra changes Thu 00:00-06:00 PT for secure rollout window.
Elliot (Customer Success): FYI — three Dedicated customers asked about recommended MLOps integrations and deployment templates; can we get a short checklist?
Priya (VP Product): Yes — adding a "Dedicated integration checklist" to docs and will ping CS when ready.
Alex (Sr Engineer): Canary metrics: p99 for long-context workloads improved ~18% so far, traces/logs posted in #eng-runtime.
Sam (CEO): Great progress. If you have blockers post them here. I'll put a one-slide exec summary in All-Hands prep. :rocket:
